name: eu.sbc-international/belgian-company-data
title: Belgian company data (KBO + Peppol) by SBC International
description: Free Belgian company lookup: KBO/BCE open data, enterprise number check and Peppol status.

tools.name: be_company_lookup
tools.description:
Look up a Belgian legal entity in the Crossroads Bank for Enterprises (KBO/BCE Open Data) by its
enterprise number (e.g. "0769.605.324", "BE0769605324" or "769605324").

Returns the official name(s), legal form, status, legal situation, start date, registered office address,
main NACE activities with descriptions (NL/FR) and website if registered. Only legal entities are covered:
numbers of natural persons (sole traders) return no data, for privacy. No e-mail or phone data is returned.

tools.name: be_company_search
tools.description:
Search active Belgian legal entities by name in KBO Open Data (legal, abbreviated and commercial names).

Optional: a 4-digit Belgian postcode of the registered office to narrow the result.
Returns at most 10 matches with enterprise number, matched name, legal form, postcode and municipality.
Natural persons are never included. Use be_company_lookup for full details of a match.

tools.name: be_enterprise_number_validate
tools.description:
Validate the format and the mod-97 check digits of a Belgian enterprise number (KBO/BCE) or Belgian VAT
number (BE + 10 digits), offline without any database. Returns the normalized forms (0769.605.324 and
BE0769605324) and whether it is an enterprise number or an establishment unit number.

tools.name: peppol_participant_lookup
tools.description:
Check whether a company is registered on the Peppol e-invoicing network, using the public Peppol
Directory (directory.peppol.eu).

Pass a Belgian enterprise number (e.g. "0769605324"): both Belgian identifier schemes are checked
(0208 = enterprise number, 9925 = VAT number). Or pass a company name for a worldwide name search
(max 10 results). Returns the Peppol participant id(s), scheme and whether Peppol BIS Billing 3.0
invoices can be received.
